title: Glossary of RideBelt terms
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Documents use many terms and acronyms (RAS-2/RAS-3, ATD, MBS, OTSR, −Gz, slack, excursion, A/W stops, H-point).
objective: Write a glossary defining every project term and acronym used in docs/, with links to where each is used.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers every acronym found in docs/ (state the search method)
Definitions are plain-language and consistent with the source documents
